kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتكوفد (form IIq)
# أَتَكَوْفَدُ (ʔatakawfadu) /ʔa.ta.kaw.fa.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
# أَتَكَوْفَدَ (ʔatakawfada) /ʔa.ta.kaw.fa.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
# أَتَكَوْفَدْ (ʔatakawfad) /ʔa.ta.kaw.fad/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
